title: Volatile Flag Synchronization between ISR and Main
description:
Any variable modified in an Interrupt Service Routine (ISR) and checked in the main application loop MUST be declared `volatile`.

The `volatile` type qualifier instructs the compiler that the variable's value can change asynchronously outside the current compiler control flow. This prevents the compiler from optimizing out repetitive reads into a CPU register.

### Requirements:
Implement `process_rx_data(uint8_t *out_byte)`: If `g_rx_ready` is 1, copy `g_rx_byte` to `*out_byte`, reset `g_rx_ready = 0`, and return 1. Otherwise return 0.
hint: Always clear the ready flag immediately after copying the data to avoid double-processing.
